$comment: PERMANENT Android release identity for S4 Security (UAT-MOB-02).
This file holds PUBLIC data only: the certificate SHA-256 fingerprint, the package id and the
expected release metadata. It contains no keystore, no alias, no password and no private key, and it
must never be made to hold any of them — the keystore itself stays outside the repository.
Why it exists: EAS Build 8 (deb416d3-565b-49b7-be4b-8b64319bb8cf) was produced with an
EAS-generated keystore instead of the retained S4 keystore, so Android refused to update the
installed 1.0.4 and the Samsung installer reported only 'App not installed'. Nothing in the release
process could see that, because the ordinary JS/Expo gate never touches a signed APK. Pinning the
expected signer here gives the post-build check something authoritative to compare against.
The fingerprint below is the certificate carried by every historical S4 APK from 1.0.0 to 1.0.5,
including the 1.0.4 currently installed on the pilot device, and by the retained keystore. An APK
signed by any other key must fail verification before it reaches a tester or a client.
TWO artefacts carry versionCode 12. `supersededBuilds` names the one that must not be distributed,
keyed by EAS build id rather than by certificate — it is correctly signed, and the defect is in its
CONTENT. `approvedArtefact` names the one that may be. A versionCode alone no longer identifies the
approved build, so anything handing an APK to a tester must check the build id or the SHA-256.

signer.subject: CN=S4 Security, OU=S4 Pilot, O=Vesoft Services Limited, C=GB

rejectedBuilds.reason: Signed with an EAS-generated keystore, not the permanent S4 identity. Cannot update an installed S4 build. Rejected for distribution; history retained.

supersededBuilds.reason: Current-shift actions could validate a historical selectedShift instead of the authoritative live shift. Confirmed on a real device: the Current Shift card showed In Progress / LIVE with a Book On recorded, while Welfare Check, Log Book and Emergency all refused with "only available during an active shift" and emitted no request. Signed correctly with the permanent S4 identity; superseded for its content, not its signer.
supersededBuilds.supersededBy: the replacement Build 12 built from aaf6c5e or a descendant

approvedArtefact.note: Must contain fix(guard): target live shift for current-shift actions. Until easBuildId and apkSha256 are recorded here, no versionCode 12 artefact is approved for distribution.
